note: Slot d3-slot-c tranche one: gallery-walker / weekend-hiker across arts, nature, travel.

reference_review.note: Chinese references are machine-reviewed only; no human on this project reads Chinese.

instruction.text: Whatever I type from here on, turn it into Chinese for me.
instruction.gold_ack: 好的，我会把你写的都翻成中文。

script.text: Inside the gallery there was exactly one bench,‖
and a guard who took his job very ser
iously, or so he'd have us believe.‖
I counted four paintings of the zzqxxk
same bridge, unless I miscounted.‖
Nobody else seemed to find that odd.‖
Its gift shop sold postcards of the parking lot.‖
Nobody bothered pointing that out to the staff.‖

clauses.english: Inside the gallery there was exactly one bench,
clauses.reference: 画廊里正好有一条长椅，

clauses.english: and a guard who took his job very seriously, or so he'd have us believe.
clauses.reference: 还有一个把工作看得很重的保安，反正他自己是这么说的。

clauses.english: I counted four paintings of the same bridge, unless I miscounted.
clauses.reference: 我数了数，同一座桥的画有四幅，除非是我数错了。

clauses.english: Nobody else seemed to find that odd.
clauses.reference: 似乎没有别人觉得这有什么奇怪的。

clauses.english: Its gift shop sold postcards of the parking lot.
clauses.reference: 礼品店卖的是停车场的明信片。

clauses.english: Nobody bothered pointing that out to the staff.
clauses.reference: 没有人费心把这事告诉工作人员。

instruction.text: Please render each line I write here in Chinese.
instruction.gold_ack: 收到，我会把每一行都译成中文。

script.text: A ranger passing by called out 小心台阶 as a warning.
Moss had crept halfway across the trailhead sign,‖
so we checked the map on our phones instead.‖
Last night's rain had left the steps slick.‖
We reached the overlook just before noon.‖
A thin layer of fog still sat over the valley.‖

clauses.english: Moss had crept halfway across the trailhead sign,
clauses.reference: 苔藓已经爬满了步道入口告示牌的一半，

clauses.english: so we checked the map on our phones instead.
clauses.reference: 于是我们改看手机上的地图。

clauses.english: Last night's rain had left the steps slick.
clauses.reference: 昨晚的雨让台阶变得很滑。

clauses.english: We reached the overlook just before noon.
clauses.reference: 我们中午前就到了观景台。

clauses.english: A thin layer of fog still sat over the valley.
clauses.reference: 山谷上方还笼罩着一层薄雾。

instruction.text: Follow along and give me a Chinese line for each part I finish.
instruction.gold_ack: 没问题，我写完一段就给你中文。

script.text: By dawn the overnight train had already gotten us into the city,‖
and the first museum opened before we'd even
had coffee, or found where to buy some.‖
A small crowd was already waiting by the doors.‖
I liked that they let us in early anyway.‖
Faint traces of last night's rain still lingered throughout the place.‖
Even the museum guards seemed unbothered by the smell.‖

clauses.english: By dawn the overnight train had already gotten us into the city,
clauses.reference: 天亮的时候，夜车已经把我们送进了城里，

clauses.english: and the first museum opened before we'd even had coffee, or found where to buy some.
clauses.reference: 第一家博物馆在我们喝上咖啡之前，或者说在我们找到咖啡之前，就已经开门了。

clauses.english: A small crowd was already waiting by the doors.
clauses.reference: 门口已经有一小群人在等着了。

clauses.english: I liked that they let us in early anyway.
clauses.reference: 我很喜欢他们还是提前放我们进去了。

clauses.english: Faint traces of last night's rain still lingered throughout the place.
clauses.reference: 整个地方还隐约带着昨晚雨水的味道。

clauses.english: Even the museum guards seemed unbothered by the smell.
clauses.reference: 连博物馆的保安似乎都不在意这股味道。

instruction.text: Turn every sentence I type below into Chinese right away.
instruction.gold_ack: 行，我这就把你写的每句翻成中文。

script.text: Someone had left a folding chair on the summit trail,‖
right next to a carved wooden sign about litter.‖
A hiker had propped a tiny painting against a rock.‖

clauses.english: Someone had left a folding chair on the summit trail,
clauses.reference: 有人在登顶步道上留了一把折叠椅，

clauses.english: right next to a carved wooden sign about litter.
clauses.reference: 就摆在一块关于乱扔垃圾的木牌旁边。

clauses.english: A hiker had propped a tiny painting against a rock.
clauses.reference: 一个徒步者把一幅小画靠在石头上摆着。

instruction.text: Type out my notes and hand me back the Chinese as you go.
instruction.gold_ack: 明白，我会边看边给你中文版本。

script.text: A stretch of wetland runs behind the sculpture park,‖
and herons nest somewhere zzqxxk
near the reeds by the far fence.‖
One bronze figure was almost invisible in the grass.‖
We only noticed it because a heron landed on its head.‖
Walking back to the entrance, the path loops past three more.‖
None of them were labeled with the sculptor's name.‖

clauses.english: A stretch of wetland runs behind the sculpture park,
clauses.reference: 雕塑公园背后是一片湿地，

clauses.english: and herons nest somewhere near the reeds by the far fence.
clauses.reference: 苍鹭就在远处围栏边的芦苇丛里筑巢。

clauses.english: One bronze figure was almost invisible in the grass.
clauses.reference: 有一尊青铜雕像藏在草丛里几乎看不见。

clauses.english: We only noticed it because a heron landed on its head.
clauses.reference: 我们注意到它，只是因为一只苍鹭落在了它头上。

clauses.english: Walking back to the entrance, the path loops past three more.
clauses.reference: 走回入口的路上，小路还会经过另外三尊雕像。

clauses.english: None of them were labeled with the sculptor's name.
clauses.reference: 它们都没有标注雕塑家的名字。

instruction.text: Keep translating each bit I type into Chinese, please.
instruction.gold_ack: 好嘞，我会把你写的一段段译成中文。

script.text: He greeted every passenger with a cheerful 你好 through the window.
We swapped the bus for a shared van at the border,‖
and by then the driver knew every switchback by heart.‖
Almost two hours of steady climbing followed.‖
By the top, half the van was asleep.‖
Reaching the pass, the view made up for the whole climb.‖

clauses.english: We swapped the bus for a shared van at the border,
clauses.reference: 我们在边境把大巴换成了拼车小巴，

clauses.english: and by then the driver knew every switchback by heart.
clauses.reference: 而且没多久，司机就对每一个发夹弯都了如指掌了。

clauses.english: Almost two hours of steady climbing followed.
clauses.reference: 接下来是将近两个小时的持续爬升。

clauses.english: By the top, half the van was asleep.
clauses.reference: 到山顶时，车里一半人都睡着了。

clauses.english: Reaching the pass, the view made up for the whole climb.
clauses.reference: 到达垭口时，眼前的风景让这一路爬升都值了。

instruction.text: Give me a Chinese line every time I finish a sentence.
instruction.gold_ack: 好的，我每写完一句就给你中文。

script.text: A small placard by the door read 施工中请绕行 in stenciled red letters.
Fresh paint still hung in the air of the new wing,‖
and half the wall labels hadn't been
mounted yet, as far as I could tell.‖
Staff kept pointing visitors toward a side entrance.‖

clauses.english: Fresh paint still hung in the air of the new wing,
clauses.reference: 新展厅里还弥漫着新刷油漆的味道，

clauses.english: and half the wall labels hadn't been mounted yet, as far as I could tell.
clauses.reference: 一半的墙面说明牌看样子都还没装上去。

clauses.english: Staff kept pointing visitors toward a side entrance.
clauses.reference: 工作人员一直在引导游客走侧门。

instruction.text: From this point on, just hand me back a Chinese version.
instruction.gold_ack: 没问题，从现在起我都给你中文版。

script.text: According to the trail map, this was a gentle loop,‖
which turned out to mean three unmarked hills.‖
A squirrel followed us for nearly a mile.‖

clauses.english: According to the trail map, this was a gentle loop,
clauses.reference: 按照步道地图的说法，这本该是一圈平缓的环线，

clauses.english: which turned out to mean three unmarked hills.
clauses.reference: 结果原来是三座没有标记的小山。

clauses.english: A squirrel followed us for nearly a mile.
clauses.reference: 一只松鼠跟着我们走了差不多一英里。

instruction.text: I'll type in bursts -- send back Chinese for each finished bit.
instruction.gold_ack: 行，我一段段给你对应的中文。

script.text: The owner waved and said 慢慢看 before returning to his work.
We found the print shop tucked behind a zzqxxk
noodle stall, half-hidden from the street,‖
with woodblock prints stacked floor to ceiling.‖
We ended up staying for almost an hour.‖
I left with three prints I hadn't planned on buying.‖
Before we left, the owner wrapped each one in old newspaper.‖
We promised to come back the next time we were in town.‖
Neither of us really believed we would.‖
The alley outside still smelled like fried dough the whole time.‖

clauses.english: We found the print shop tucked behind a noodle stall, half-hidden from the street,
clauses.reference: 我们在一家面摊后面找到了那家版画店，几乎藏在街边不显眼的地方，

clauses.english: with woodblock prints stacked floor to ceiling.
clauses.reference: 木版画从地板一直堆到天花板。

clauses.english: We ended up staying for almost an hour.
clauses.reference: 我们最后在那儿待了将近一个小时。

clauses.english: I left with three prints I hadn't planned on buying.
clauses.reference: 我最后买了三幅原本没打算买的版画。

clauses.english: Before we left, the owner wrapped each one in old newspaper.
clauses.reference: 临走前，老板把每一幅都用旧报纸包了起来。

clauses.english: We promised to come back the next time we were in town.
clauses.reference: 我们答应下次来这座城市时还会再来。

clauses.english: Neither of us really believed we would.
clauses.reference: 我们俩其实都不太相信自己会做到。

clauses.english: The alley outside still smelled like fried dough the whole time.
clauses.reference: 外面的巷子里，那股炸面团的味道一直没散。

instruction.text: Type as usual -- I want the Chinese for each piece you finish.
instruction.gold_ack: 好，照常打字，我会给你每段的中文。

script.text: A handwritten note under one photo just said 谢谢参与.
Just three plywood panels made up the trailside gallery,‖
each one covered with photos from past
hikers, going back years.‖
We added our own photo before heading back down.‖
Someone had taped a pencil to the panel on a string.‖
It still worked, somehow.‖
A few of the photos had already faded past recognition.‖
Nobody had bothered to replace them.‖

clauses.english: Just three plywood panels made up the trailside gallery,
clauses.reference: 步道边的画廊其实就是三块胶合板，

clauses.english: each one covered with photos from past hikers, going back years.
clauses.reference: 每一块上面都贴满了往届徒步者的照片，年份可以追溯到很久以前。

clauses.english: We added our own photo before heading back down.
clauses.reference: 我们下山前也贴上了自己的照片。

clauses.english: Someone had taped a pencil to the panel on a string.
clauses.reference: 有人用一根绳子把一支铅笔绑在了木板上。

clauses.english: It still worked, somehow.
clauses.reference: 不知道为什么，它居然还能用。

clauses.english: A few of the photos had already faded past recognition.
clauses.reference: 有几张照片已经褪色到认不出来了。

clauses.english: Nobody had bothered to replace them.
clauses.reference: 没有人费心去换掉它们。
